title: Dallas Oktoberfest Beer & Bites Walking Tour
includes: Gratuity for your guide is not included in ticket price. Gratuity is not mandatory but appreciated.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for vegetarian or vegan diet
Not recommended for guests not able to safely navigate uneven terrain
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This 2 hour walking tour (more like a casual stroll) visits a craft brewery and a chili parlor along historic Main Street where you will experience a variety of craft beer and food pairings. In between the tastings, you will learn about Grapevine’s rich history, culture and architecture including a stop at The Peace Circle which played an important part in the establishment of the entire Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex and the Grapevine Observation Tower where you will ascend 150 feet for an amazing view of the DFW Metroplex.
